name: BGE (BAAI)
desc: BAAI (Beijing Academy of AI) BGE family — bge-large/base/small + bge-m3 multilingual + bge-reranker. One of the most widely-used open embedding families.
deployment: Self-hosted only — open weights on Hugging Face (FlagEmbedding library); also served by third-party inference APIs

name: Cohere Embed
desc: Cohere's hosted embedding models, now Embed 5 (2026-09-30; Pro and Fast tiers): text, image and fused text-plus-image inputs, 100+ languages, 128K-token context, Matryoshka output dimensions from 256 to 2048 with float, int8 and binary formats. Reranker API (Rerank 5).
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — Cohere API and Model Vault; deployable in customer cloud via Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry and Oracle OCI
pricing: Model Vault dedicated instances: Embed 5 Fast/Pro Small $3.00/hour ($2,000/month), Medium $5.00/hour ($3,250/month); Rerank 5 Fast Medium $4.00/hour ($2,500/mon

name: GTE (Alibaba-NLP)
desc: Alibaba DAMO Academy's GTE family — open-weight multilingual embedding models; gte-large/base/small + Qwen-based gte-Qwen2.
deployment: Self-hosted only — open weights on Hugging Face

name: Hugging Face Inference API (Embeddings)
desc: HF's hosted Inference API and Inference Endpoints — serve any model from the Hub including the BGE/GTE/E5 embedding families.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — managed Inference Providers and Inference Endpoints; self-hosted Text Embeddings Inference (TEI)
pricing: Inference Providers pay-as-you-go at provider rates with no Hugging Face markup; PRO users get $2.00/month credits, Team/Enterprise $2.00 per seat; Inference En
license: proprietary service; huggingface_hub SDK Apache-2.0; Text Embeddings Inference A

name: Jina AI Embeddings
desc: Jina AI's embedding family — jina-embeddings-v3 (multilingual), jina-clip-v2 (text+image), jina-colbert-v2. Open-weights + hosted API + ColBERT-style.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — hosted Jina API; open weights and jina-on-prem air-gapped Docker/K8s; SageMaker
license: mixed — many recent open-weight models CC-BY-NC-4.0 (commercial licence via Elas

name: Mistral Embed
desc: Mistral AI's hosted embedding API — mistral-embed; available via Mistral La Plateforme and Azure AI.
pricing: mistral-embed $0.10 per 1M tokens; Codestral Embed $0.15 per 1M tokens; batch API 50% cheaper

name: Mixedbread AI
desc: Hosted embedding and reranker APIs — mxbai-embed-large + reranker. Open-weight models + paid API + agentic search.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — managed Mixedbread API (BYOC/BYOB on Enterprise); Apache-2.0 open-weight models self-hostable
pricing: Starter free ($5 one-time credits); Scale $20/month (includes $20 credits, then pay-as-you-go); Enterprise custom. Indexing $1.50/1M tokens (Fast) or $3 (High Q
license: proprietary API; open-weight models Apache-2.0 (mxbai-embed-large-v1, mxbai-rera

name: Nomic Embed
desc: Nomic's open-weight embedding models (nomic-embed-text-v1.5, nomic-embed-vision). Nomic Atlas for vector dataset exploration.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — Apache-2.0 open weights on Hugging Face; hosted models via Nomic Agent API (Business/Enterprise)
pricing: Open weights free; Nomic platform Free, Individual $20/month, Business $40/user/month (25-seat minimum, includes Agent API), Enterprise custom

name: OpenAI Embeddings
desc: OpenAI's hosted embedding API — text-embedding-3-small, text-embedding-3-large. Most widely used commercial embedding API in OSS RAG/memory stacks.
pricing: text-embedding-3-small $0.02 per 1M tokens; text-embedding-3-large $0.13 per 1M tokens

name: Sentence Transformers
desc: Reimers & Gurevych's library for training sentence embeddings — substrate under most open-weight embedding models. Now under Hugging Face.

name: Voyage AI (MongoDB)
desc: Specialised embedding and reranker provider — voyage-3, voyage-multilingual, voyage-finance, voyage-law, voyage-code. Acquired by MongoDB Feb 2025 for $220M.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — Voyage API; AWS and Azure Marketplace model packages in customer VPC; on-prem and model licensing by request
pricing: Per-token with free allowance: voyage-4-large $0.12/1M tokens, voyage-4 $0.06, voyage-4-lite $0.02 (first 200M tokens free); rerank-3 $0.05/1M, rerank-3-lite $0

name: Clarivate
desc: Bibliographic metadata curation (Web of Science, Derwent, Cortellis). Human editorial governance + journal-deindexing. Memory-adjacent — included as a curated-knowledge baseline.

name: Coveo
desc: RAG-as-a-Service for AWS (Dec 2025) via hosted MCP server grounding Amazon Bedrock agents in enterprise knowledge. Passage retrieval + answer generation + ranked search + fetch in one API.

name: Glean
desc: Enterprise search with 100+ connectors. Personalised per-user knowledge graph. No governance layer.

name: Lucidworks Conversational Q&A AI Agent
desc: Enterprise Q&A agent powered by Luci patent-pending ultra-precise RAG. Embeds on product detail pages; consumes technical PDFs, spec sheets, images, tables, charts, graphs and product manuals. Maintains session history for multi-turn follow-ups; refuses out-of-scope queries via prompt-injection guard.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — Lucidworks Platform SaaS; self-hosted Fusion

name: Meilisearch
desc: Semantic + hybrid search GA (2025). Automatic embedding generation + caching via OpenAI / HuggingFace / Ollama. Multi-modal (text + images); hybrid rank fusion; conversational RAG built in.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — OSS binary/Docker; Meilisearch Cloud
license: MIT (Community Edition) / BSL-1.1 (source-available, Enterprise Edition parts)

name: Mindbreeze InSpire
desc: Hybrid keyword + vector retrieval with entitlement-aware filtering. Unified enterprise knowledge graph linking documents, tickets, records. RAG prompt orchestration built in.

name: SearchUnify
desc: Agentic enterprise search with Knowbler — quality checks via the KCS (Knowledge-Centered Service) standard. Most explicit governance features in the segment.

name: Sinequa
desc: Hybrid retrieval combining dense vector + keyword + graph traversal + multimodal. Agentic RAG grounding AI agents in internal knowledge. SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliant.

name: AllegroGraph (Franz)
desc: RDF triple/quad store with RDFS++ / OWL reasoning. v8.4 (May 2025) added an NLQ interface.

name: Amazon Neptune Analytics
desc: Vector index on graph nodes queryable via openCypher. Mem0 integration GA 2025; Cognee integration for agentic RAG. Combines semantic recall with multi-hop traversal in one managed service.
pricing: Pay-per-use — billed per m-NCU-hour (1 m-NCU = 1 GB memory plus compute for 1 hour), $0.03 per m-NCU-hour in us-east-1 (16 m-NCU graph = $0.48/hour); paused gra
type: Vector + graph in one managed service

name: Apache AGE
desc: openCypher over Postgres. Pairs with pgvector for graph + vector hybrid retrieval. Azure Database for PostgreSQL ships AGE with ai_extension LLM functions for entity extraction directly in SQL.
deployment: Self-hosted only — PostgreSQL extension (PG 11–18); some managed Postgres services (e.g. Azure) offer it

name: ArangoDB
desc: HybridGraphRAG combines vector search, graph traversal, full-text in one AQL query. ArangoGraphML for ML pipelines; LangChain integration.
license: BSL-1.1 (source-available; each release converts to Apache-2.0 four years after

name: Dgraph
desc: Vector indexing on any node. Google Gen AI Toolbox integration; LangChain agent orchestration.
deployment: Both (self-hosted OSS + Hypermode Cloud until Oct 2025 acquisition by Istari)

name: Diffbot
desc: Auto-built knowledge graph from web crawl. 1T+ facts, 10B+ entities. GraphRAG-fine-tuned model based on open-source Llama 3.3.
pricing: Free $0/month (10,000 credits); Startup $299/month (250,000 credits, overage $0.001/credit); Startup Plus $899/month (1,000,000 credits, overage $0.0009/credit)

name: FalkorDB
desc: Native GraphRAG SDK. Graph-memory backend for Mem0; MCP server via Graphiti integration; context graphs for long-term agent memory.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — OSS server/Docker; FalkorDB Cloud (free trial)

name: Kuzu
desc: Embedded property-graph database (Cypher) with a built-in vector index and full-text search, widely used as an embedded store for agent memory and GraphRAG. The kuzudb/kuzu repository was archived on 2025-10-10 after Apple acquired the company; 0.11.3 is the final release and earlier releases remain usable.
deployment: Self-hosted only (embedded library; no managed cloud at time of acquisition)
pricing: Free (MIT-licensed open source); acquired by Apple so no commercial cloud

name: Memgraph
desc: In-memory GraphRAG engine. Memgraph 3.0 adds native vector search alongside graph traversal. LangChain toolkit.
license: BSL-1.1 (source-available, Community); Enterprise under proprietary MEL

name: NebulaGraph
desc: v5.2 adds graph-vector-text hybrid retrieval natively. MCP server for Claude/GPT agents. GraphRAG in three lines of code.
